info.title: Team Task & Sprint Tracker API
info.description:
REST API for managing team tasks and sprints.

**Auth:** call `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then click **Authorize** and paste the `access_token`. Demo accounts: `admin@demo.com` / `member@demo.com`, password `Password123!`.

Every response uses the envelope `{success, data, meta, error}`.
